reason: The patch adds an abstract `int order()` with no default to the ServiceLoader-loaded interface at common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoProvider.java:44, which breaks any out-of-tree implementation, yet it touches no docs file and no .adoc in the repo mentions CryptoProvider.
